backgroundSpec.description: Scene background. Either a color token (e.g. 'shade1'), a literal hex string, or an object { color?, texture?, blendMode?, opacity? }. color resolves via resolveColorToken; texture resolves via resolveTextureToken (a textures.* token → public/ path).

oneOf.description: a color token (e.g. 'shade1') or a literal #RRGGBB hex string

color.description: color token or literal #RRGGBB; resolved via resolveColorToken

texture.description: texture token from styles.textures; resolved to a public/ path via resolveTextureToken

blendMode.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the texture overlay. Defaults to 'normal'.

opacity.description: opacity of the texture overlay, 0–1. Defaults to 1.

timingAnchor.description: A timing anchor for an effect/camera event. Exactly one of: offsetPercent, relativeToAsset, relativeToCameraAction.
